attchmntText: Page Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 12, 2026, declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 150 per equity share.
voiceSummary: Page Industries Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026, approved by the Board on 12 November 2026. The company declared a second interim dividend of Rs.150 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date is 18 November 2026, with payment due on or before 11 December 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was 1,43,960.98 lakhs, compared to 1,29,085.82 lakhs in the corresponding period. Profit for the period stood at 20,254.41 lakhs, up from 19,476.01 lakhs previously. Earnings per share were 181.59. Total assets as of 30 September 2026 were 3,09,915.85 lakhs. The limited review report by the statutory auditor is enclosed with the announcement.

attchmntText: Page Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 12, 2026, titled "Press Release and Investor Presentation".
voiceSummary: Page Industries Limited filed a press release and investor presentation for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The company reported revenue of Rs. 14,396 million for Q2 FY27, representing an 11.5% year-on-year growth. Sales volume reached 59.7 million pieces, up 5.5% year-on-year. EBITDA stood at Rs. 3,001 million with a margin of 20.8%, while Profit After Tax was Rs. 2,025 million, a 4% year-on-year increase. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue was Rs. 28,601 million, growing 9.7% year-on-year. EBITDA was Rs. 5,891 million, and Profit After Tax was Rs. 3,954 million. The filing was submitted by Arjun Sunil Makhecha, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, on 12 November 2026.

attchmntText: Page Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet on 16 and 17 November 2026
voiceSummary: Page Industries Limited has intimated the schedule for analyst and institutional investor meetings under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Regulations. The company will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Conference 2026 in Mumbai. Meetings are scheduled for 16 November 2026 and 17 November 2026. The timings for both days are 10 AM to 5 PM. The meetings will include group sessions and one-on-one interactions. The mode of the conference is physical. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. All discussions will be based on generally available information. No price sensitive information will be shared. The intimation is available on the company website. Arjun Sunil Makhecha, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, issued this notice.
